party_a_statement: My neighbour has illegally constructed a wall 2 feet inside my property boundary. I have the original property documents and survey map clearly showing the boundary. This construction has reduced my usable land and blocked my window. The construction happened 6 months ago while I was travelling. I want the wall demolished and compensation for damages of 50000 INR.
party_b_statement: The wall I constructed is entirely within my property boundary. I have my own property documents showing this. The survey my neighbour is referring to is outdated and incorrect. I got a fresh survey done by a licensed surveyor before construction which confirmed the wall is on my land. I am not willing to demolish anything.
